# Lisse

> Small JavaScript library that draws squircle corners — the same continuous curve Figma and iOS use. Bindings for React, Vue, and Svelte, plus a framework-agnostic core. Per-corner control, borders, and shadows included.

Lisse (rhymes with "lease") implements Figma's corner-smoothing algorithm in JavaScript. It generates SVG paths and CSS `clip-path` values that produce visually smooth corners, distinct from CSS `border-radius` which uses quarter-circles. MIT-licensed, TypeScript-first, zero runtime dependencies in the core.

## Site

- [Homepage](https://corne.rs/): dictionary-style overview with a live squircle-vs-CSS comparison demo
- [What?](https://corne.rs/what): plain-language explanation of squircles and why they differ from CSS rounded corners
- [Playground](https://corne.rs/playground): interactive parameter tuning — radius, smoothing, per-corner control, borders, shadows

## Packages

- [@lisse/core](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lisse/core): framework-agnostic path generator; zero dependencies
- [@lisse/react](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lisse/react): React hook (`useSmoothCorners`) and component (`<SmoothCorners>`)
- [@lisse/vue](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lisse/vue): Vue composable and component
- [@lisse/svelte](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lisse/svelte): Svelte action and component
